title: Conductors for Electronics and Telecommunication Applications: Tinsel Conductors
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the tinsel conductors for use in the manufacture of telephone and audio cords.
clause_3_terminology: Conductors for Electronics and Telecommunication Applications: Tinsel Conductors

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
